title: Strict completion normalization of the integral mates
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D=(k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an algebraic closure $\Omega$ and an embedding $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $X_0$ be separated and of finite type over $k_0$, and let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$, $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be complementary open and closed immersions [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Their base changes, specified coefficient functors and mate predicates are those of [def-sf-open-closed-weil-mate-data]. Then sfCompletionOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀. Its notions and specified comparisons use [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sf-integral-open-operations], [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data], [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data], [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data], [def-zl-common-stage-weil-shriek], [def-zl-frobenius-compact-support-comparison], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-adjunction], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction], [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

proof.text: Apply the immersion completed-pullback comparison to the open and closed maps and the three Frobenius automorphisms. Its finite-generator normalization constructs the ordinary coefficient transport rho₀. Deriving its computation counit constructs rho and fixes the displayed complex equation. Complete representatives exist by the completion equivalence. The strict completion unit, unit-normalized tower/reflector comparison and inverse gamma give the five inclusion comparisons. Finite-Hom Mittag-Leffler uniqueness shows the pin holds for every normalized Comparison and every representative. The normalized open Roos and closed derived adjunctions identify the fixed adjoint mates. The composition coherence of the pinned pullback comparisons gives the b/d cubes; mate unit/counit identities and mate pasting give the remaining equations.

theorem sf_openClosed_weil_completion_stage
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (_ιE : E →ₐ[Padic l] Ω)
    {X₀ U₀ Z₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U₀.hom] [QuasiCompact U₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₀.hom]
    (j₀ : U₀ ⟶ X₀) (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ X₀)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [IsClosedImmersion i₀.left]
    (_hij : Set.range i₀.left.base = (Set.range j₀.left.base)ᶜ) :
    sfCompletionOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀
